# Dotfiles

A collection of my personal dotfiles for a customized and efficient terminal experience, featuring Oh My Zsh with powerful plugins and a beautiful theme.

## Features
- Powerlevel10k theme for a modern, informative prompt
- Syntax highlighting for better command readability
- Smart command auto-suggestions
- Custom ZSH configuration

## Installation

### Prerequisites
1. Install [Oh My Zsh](https://github.com/ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh):
```bash
sh -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh/master/tools/install.sh)"
```

### Quick Setup
Run this single command to install:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/se7uh/dotfiles && cd dotfiles && bash install.sh
```

That's it! Restart your terminal and enjoy your newly configured environment! 🚀
